Definition & Logic: Unique numerical patient identifier (Primary Key, N=500).
Patient age in years (validated and standardized).
Patient gender (Female, Male, Other).
City of residence across 8 UK/Irish metropolitan areas.
Patient occupation (standardized; <18 classified as Student).
Health insurance provider (Provider A-D or 'Uninsured').
Recorded hereditary condition (Cancer, Diabetes, Heart Disease, Hypertension, None).
Highest educational attainment level (Pre-school to PhD).
Marital status (Single, Married, Divorced, Widowed).
Median cleaned annual income (£) of the patient.
10-year age bracket (0-9, 10-19, ..., 90+) for demographic grouping.
Income quartile segment (Q1 Lowest to Q4 Highest).
Total number of consultations between Jan 1 and Jun 30, 2024.
Count of unique clinical departments visited by the patient.
Modal (most frequently visited) hospital department.
Mean consultation duration in minutes across all visits.
Cumulative duration in minutes spent across all consultations.
Count of consultations taking place on Saturday or Sunday.
Count of consultations taking place Monday through Friday.
Ratio of weekend visits to weekday visits (Weekend / max(1, Weekday)).
Proportion of patient visits occurring on weekends.
Cumulative gross billed consultation cost (£) across all visits.
Mean gross price (£) per consultation.
Total amount (£) paid by insurance provider across all visits.
Mean insurance coverage (£) per consultation.
Total out-of-pocket expenditure (£) paid by patient (Price - Coverage).
Mean out-of-pocket expenditure (£) per consultation.
Proportion of total consultation costs paid out-of-pocket by patient.
Mean satisfaction rating (1 = lowest, 5 = highest; valid ratings only).
Lowest satisfaction rating submitted by patient across visits.
Highest satisfaction rating submitted by patient across visits.
Number of consultations receiving a dissatisfied score (<= 2).
Proportion of patient consultations rated <= 2.
Days elapsed from patient's first consultation to July 1, 2024.
Days elapsed from patient's most recent consultation to July 1, 2024.
Days between first and last recorded visit (clinical engagement span).
Average monthly consultation frequency (Total_Visits / 6.0 months).
